If you're looking for **smart lock installation in Maidstone (Kent, UK)**, there are several well-reviewed locksmiths that install smart locks for uPVC, composite, timber, and aluminium doors.

Some highly rated options include:

- Mckenz-key Locksmith – 24/7 locksmith with strong customer reviews.
- The Pick of the Bunch Locksmiths Limited – Offers 24-hour locksmith services with excellent ratings.
- Cutting Edge Locksmith – Experienced in residential lock installations and available 24/7.
- A Short Locksmith – Provides smart lock fitting and emergency locksmith services. [www.checkatrade.com](https://www.checkatrade.com/Search/Digital-Smart-Door-Lock-Installation/in/Maidstone?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.lockrite.org](https://www.lockrite.org/Maidstone/yale-smart-security-partner.php?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Typical installation costs in the Maidstone area are approximately:
- **£100–£280** for installation, depending on the door type and lock complexity.
- The smart lock itself is usually purchased separately unless supplied by the installer. [www.checkatrade.com](https://www.checkatrade.com/Search/Digital-Smart-Door-Lock-Installation/in/Maidstone?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Many local locksmiths can install popular brands such as:
- Yale
- Nuki
- Ultion Nuki
- Tedee
- SwitchBot
- Aqara (depending on door compatibility) [www.checkatrade.com](https://www.checkatrade.com/Search/Digital-Smart-Door-Lock-Installation/in/Maidstone?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.lockrite.org](https://www.lockrite.org/Maidstone/yale-smart-security-partner.php?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Before booking, it's worth checking:
- Your door material (uPVC, composite, timber, aluminium).
- Whether you have a euro cylinder or mortice lock.
- Whether you want remote app control, fingerprint access, keypad entry, or integration with Apple Home, Google Home, or Alexa.

If you already have a smart lock model in mind, I can also tell you whether it's compatible with your door and what installation should cost.
